title: Complete-SVD: A Functional Norm Approach to Low-Rank LLM Compression
abstract: arXiv:2611.26059v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-training low-rank compression of neural networks must not only approximate the original weights but also preserve the model's input-output behavior. Recent output-aware methods measure the compression error beyond the compressed layer, at the model output, weighting logit changes by the observed next token or by the model's predicted probabilities. We propose Complete-SVD, a method for large language models that minimizes the $L_2$ distance between the logits of the original and compressed models, weighting all logit changes equally. Linearizing the network around the original weights, together with a Kronecker-factored approximation, reduces this objective to a weighted SVD with a closed-form solution. Its output-side factor is intractable to compute; we estimate it without bias from random probes, at a cost of $K$ backward passes per sequence, independent of vocabulary size and sequence length. translated_title: Complete-SVD：一种面向大语言模型低秩压缩的泛函数范数方法
translated_abstract: 神经网络的训练后低秩压缩不仅需要近似原始权重，还必须保持模型的输入输出行为。近期的输出感知方法在压缩层之外、即模型输出处度量压缩误差，通过观察到的下一个token或模型预测的概率对logit变化进行加权。我们提出Complete-SVD，一种面向大语言模型的方法，它最小化原始模型与压缩模型logit之间的L2距离，并对所有logit变化进行等权处理。通过在原始权重附近对网络进行线性化，并结合Kronecker因子分解近似，该目标函数被化简为具有闭式解的加权SVD。其输出侧因子难以直接计算；我们通过随机探测对其进行无偏估计，每个序列的代价仅为K次反向传播，且该成本与词表大小和序列长度无关。在相同设置与均匀……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Complete-SVD方法，通过最小化原始与压缩模型logit之间的等权L2距离，将大语言模型低秩压缩目标化简为具有闭式解的加权SVD，并利用随机探测以与词表大小和序列长度无关的计算成本无偏估计难以求解的输出侧因子。
en_tdlr: Complete-SVD formulates LLM low-rank compression as minimizing the L2 distance between original and compressed model logits with equal weighting, reduces it to a weighted SVD with a closed-form solution via linearization and Kronecker factorization, and unbiasedly estimates the intractable output-side factor using random probes at a cost independent of vocabulary size and sequence length.
